project_type: Modular-monolith Clinical Artifact Platform: FastAPI backend (src/app) + durable Postgres job worker (workers/) + React/Vite frontend (frontend/) with an orval-generated typed API client
build_system: uv + setuptools (src layout; packages under src/app). Alembic single ordered migration history. Frontend: npm + vite + orval. mypy strict (config packages=['app']); docs/CI invoke 'mypy src workers'.
test_framework: pytest (tests/unit, tests/contract fast; tests/integration/tests/conformance/tests/e2e service-backed), Hypothesis for property tests, Testcontainers/Compose for Postgres+MinIO. Frontend: vitest.
build_command: ruff check . ; ruff format --check . ; mypy src workers
test_command: pytest tests/unit tests/contract  (fast) ; AURINARA_INTEGRATION=1 pytest tests/integration (service-backed)
verification_instructions: Narrowest first: (1) ruff check . && ruff format --check . ; (2) mypy src workers ; (3) pytest tests/unit tests/contract ; (4) migration from empty DB against a fresh clinical_test: uv run alembic upgrade head, uv run alembic downgrade -1, uv run alembic upgrade head (expect single head via 'alembic heads'); (5) with Compose Postgres+MinIO up and AURINARA_INTEGRATION=1: pytest tests/integration ; (6) frontend typed client: cd frontend && npm run api:sync && npm run typecheck. Integration fixtures reuse MemoryStorage/TestTokenVerifier from tests/integration/test_phase1_core.py and make_test_settings() from tests/conftest.py; the Phase 3 suite skips unless AURINARA_INTEGRATION=1.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/src/api/generated/** and frontend/openapi.json are generated by `npm run api:sync` (api:export reads the FastAPI app via scripts/export-openapi.mjs, then `orval --config orval.config.ts` splits per OpenAPI tag into src/api/generated with schemas under model/, clean:true). The backend typed-client fixture tests/contract/typed_client_fixture.py (PHASE3_RAW_SDTM_OPERATIONS) is hand-maintained and asserted by tests/contract/test_phase3.py. There is NO hand-written frontend fixture to edit.
environment_constraints: Do ALL work in the worktree e:\Work\EDETEK\Python\aurinara\.worktrees\raw-bulk-upload on branch raw-bulk-upload (based on master, NOT mainline). Use git -C <worktree>. Relative paths resolve to the PARENT workspace, so use absolute paths. Integration suites TRUNCATE tables and must run against clinical_test (make_test_settings forces a _test DB); never the dev DB. Commit locally on the branch; never push.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: generated/source files immutable + checksum-addressed; validate entire bulk import before commit (all-or-nothing); 202 + Idempotency-Key + status resource for async long work; durable Postgres queue with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, lease, retries, typed failures, cooperative cancellation, NO open DB transaction across object-store I/O; common ValidationIssue model with stable codes (do not parse messages); cross-module access only via typed service interfaces (worker imports service.py, never routes.py); one Alembic migration per schema change, reversible, tests apply from empty DB; snake_case JSON, UUIDs, RFC3339 UTC, RFC9457 problem+json, closed enums as Literals; never return object keys/paths/secrets; register owned collections in the ModuleDescriptor (but raw_dataset_import is an OPERATION ROW, not an entity_type).
key_patterns: ArtifactService.create_source_file (artifacts/service.py): validate filename+media-type first, stream to temp file enforcing source_file_max_bytes, SHA-256, checksum_object_key, put_file, finally-unlink, then commit. create_artifact_build (artifacts/builds.py): idempotency via IdempotencyRecord(route/study_id/subject/key, request_fingerprint=fingerprint(model_dump(mode='json'))), 202 + Location, replay = bare model_validate return (emits 202 under the 202 decorator), reuse = 409 idempotency_key_reused. Worker handlers (workers/job_worker.py _handle_artifact_build/_handle_reconciliation/_handle_validation): T1 short txn -> untransacted middle (object I/O) -> T2 short txn; cancellation guard at both boundaries; JobService.claim (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), JobService.complete (idempotent), JobService.fail (REQUEUES while attempt_count<max_attempts). _record_failure per job_type marks the operation failed only when job.status=='failed'. Raw single create_dataset: _source -> inspect_file -> RawDataset -> binding_for -> raw.revision+=1 -> _stale (artifacts.mark_owner_stale + Raw ValidationRun stale + SDTM STALENESS handler). inspect_file/read_rows (raw/files.py) raise ProblemException with codes raw_file_format_unsupported / raw_physical_schema_invalid / raw_json_shape_invalid. fingerprint = app.common.canonical.fingerprint (sha256 hex of canonical JSON).
directory_structure: src/app/<module> packages (raw, artifacts, execution, common, kernel, validation, reconciliation, studies, ...) each owning routes/contracts/service/models/descriptor; workers/ durable job worker (job_worker.py); migrations/versions/ single Alembic chain (current head 20261009_0012); tests/{unit,contract,integration,conformance,e2e}; docs/ operating contracts; frontend/ React app with generated client under src/api/generated (regenerated by npm run api:sync).
